app.title: Flier Studio
app.lead: Fill the form, pick a format and a layout, download the PNGs. Everything stays in your browser.

allFliers.heading: All fliers
allFliers.note: Every setting here changes all {{p1}} fliers. A flier's own Layout card can still override it.
allFliers.themeWhat: Colours, fonts and the picture style of every flier

replace.word: Whole word only (capital letters never matter)

replace.note: A draft is saved first, so Drafts can undo it.
